retrievalProfile.description: A close-up female portrait set against a textured, scratched metallic surface with modern geometric typography integrated into the background space.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up of a woman with dark wavy hair wearing a black leather jacket, positioned off-center against a vertical-grain brushed metal wall. The lighting is cool and directional, creating high-contrast highlights on the leather and skin, while the typography is a clean, geometric sans-serif that uses horizontal rules to anchor the text to the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned on the left third to balance text on the right
High-gloss leather texture contrasting against matte scratched metal
Cool blue-grey background tones contrasting with warm skin tones
Horizontal typographic rules echoing the industrial lines of the background
coreInvariants: Black leather jacket with visible zipper details

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes serve as the primary focal point, supported by the high-contrast leather jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the diagonal of the shoulder, across to the text block on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right third of the image is dedicated to the metallic background and typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey and steel blue (background and highlights)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and rose (skin tones and lips)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic background and dark subject; low saturation overall except for skin tones.

letterConstructionRules: Extended horizontal bars connecting or underlining specific letters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'j' lacks a top hook, appearing as a simple vertical line with a curve
The 's' is highly stylized with a geometric, almost circular flow
Horizontal rules extend from the descenders or baselines to create a shelf effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying weights or horizontal graphic accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Perfect geometric circles and clean lines match the base skeleton.
Classic geometric proportions suitable for modification.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with dark wavy hair wearing a black leather jacket against a scratched, brushed steel wall. Use cool studio lighting with blue-grey tints.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a two-line lowercase geometric sans-serif text block on the right side. Include a thin horizontal black line extending from the bottom of the second word.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visibly scratched and metallic?
Is the text entirely lowercase and geometric?
Is the subject positioned to the left to allow for negative space on the right?
Are the skin tones natural against the cool-toned background?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the metal texture does not look like flat grey paint.
Verify the leather jacket has realistic specular highlights.
Check that the typography is legible against the texture.
Confirm the composition follows the rule of thirds.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Portrait) + Texture(Brushed Metal) + Lighting(Cool/High Contrast) + Type(Geometric Lowercase Sans) = Urban Pop Aesthetic
